bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative adversarial prompting and red teaming, such as evaluating model responses to prompts asking it to calculate attractiveness based on gender, or testing jailbreaks that encourage misogynistic viewpoints.

Qualitative adversarial prompting and red teaming, such as evaluating model responses to prompts asking it to calculate attractiveness based on race, or testing prompts requesting discriminatory content against specific racial groups.

Qualitative adversarial prompting, including evaluating the model's willingness to generate offensive jokes targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Muslims) or testing its ability to refuse generating anti-Semitic hate speech.
Qualitative adversarial prompting, such as testing the model with requests to write offensive jokes about individuals who use a wheelchair.
Qualitative evaluations of model outputs to identify implicit societal biases and stereotypes, such as analyzing prompts about marriage to see if the model defaults to heterosexual norms.
Quantitative evaluation of model performance disparities and quality of service across different languages using translated academic benchmarks like MMLU.
